summary: Vivos Therapeutics filed an 8-K disclosing a Collaboration Agreement with South Palm Cardiovascular Associates to form AIM Florida, a management services organization (MSO) that will provide non-clinical support to affiliated professional entities delivering sleep apnea diagnostic and treatment services, initially in Palm Beach County, Florida. Vivos expects to hold at least 80% of membership interests and SPCVA up to 20%, with Vivos' subsidiary as manager. SPCVA's investment is at fair market value, with distributions proportional to ownership. No price/share, premium, or deal value stated. The collaboration is still subject to definitive documentation and regulatory requirements. Watch for execution risk and regulatory approvals.
